subject: [PATCH v4 6/8] mm/hugetlb: retry the pool walk when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the hugetlb pool walk to retry when the zonelist is rebuilt during zone online. This prevents a hugetlb fault from taking a page from an incorrect node due to the rebuild shifting nodes in the zonelist. The patch checks for zonelist updates and restarts the walk if necessary, resetting the last-tried node on each restart.
